value.rationale: Sun explicitly asks for a universal signed primitive-root quadratic character bound and existence of both signs. The safe-prime family permits an exact character-sum identity, improves its logarithmic envelope to a sharp-at-two-primes square-root bound, and yields the exact threshold and quantitative counts. These are distributional facts beyond Booker et al.'s already known large-safe-prime existence implications; the Hasse machinery is standard rather than newly claimed.
